name: keirost-setup-workspace
description: Instalador y aplicación de escritorio de Keirost

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @keirost/setup-ui && npm run build --workspace @keirost/desktop-ui
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @keirost/setup-ui && npm run typecheck --workspace @keirost/desktop-ui
scripts.icons: node tools/make-icon.mjs --out apps/setup/src-tauri/icons && node tools/make-icon.mjs --out apps/desktop/src-tauri/icons
